lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits. The spots are arranged in a grid-like matrix with consistent vertical and horizontal spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges exhibit a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity, with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges running longitudinally across the upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A specific 'target' mark consisting of a circular or elliptical ring surrounding a single high-luminance spot on the lateral flank, indicated by a blue arrow. Also, irregular white markings/abrasions are visible on the leading edge of the pectoral fin.
